    LaTeX equations for the covariate effects of the FFEM

    fremEqLatex.Rd

    Writes the covariate effects of the FFEM of a FREM model as LaTeX, one equation per parameter, ready to be put in a report. Each equation is a sum of terms, one per covariate: the coefficient times the covariate minus its mean, for example

    COV_CL = -0.00591 (WT - 86.9) - 0.0287 (HT - 170) + ...

    Usage

    fremEqLatex(
  dfext = NULL,
  numNonFREMThetas = NULL,
  numSkipOm = NULL,
  covNames = NULL,
  parNames = NULL,
  availCov = covNames,
  runno = NULL,
  modName = NULL,
  modDevDir = NULL,
  name_map = NULL,
  level_map = NULL,
  perLine = 3,
  digits = 3,
  quiet = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    dfext

    A data frame of the ext file of the FREM model, as from getExt(). If NULL (default), the ext file of the model found with runno or modName (and modDevDir) is read.

    numNonFREMThetas

    Number of structural (non-FREM-covariate) THETAs in the FREM model. If NULL (default), it is derived from the model file found with runno or modName (and modDevDir) and the ext, with fremModelInfo(); a supplied value that disagrees with the derived one gives a warning and is kept.

    numSkipOm

    Number of diagonal OMEGAs before the FREM block that are not part of the FREM calculations. Derived as numNonFREMThetas is when NULL (default); without a model, 0.

    covNames

    Names of the FREM covariates, in the order of the model, as in calcFFEM(). If NULL (default), they are read from the model file with getCovNames(). When the model file is found, a covNames that differs from the covariates of the model in content or order stops the function, because the coefficients are attached to the names by position.

    parNames

    Names of the parameters with covariate effects, as in calcFFEM(), one per row of the coefficients. They are used in the left-hand side of each equation (COV_CL). If NULL (default), Par1, Par2, and so on.

    availCov

    Names of the covariates in the FFEM: all of covNames (the default) or a subset, as in calcFFEM(). The terms follow the order of covNames. With no covariates, each equation is COV = 0.

    runno

    The run number. Must be provided if modName is NULL. Will be used to create NONMEM model and results file names with the structure run#.mod and run#. NONMEM ext, phi and cov files will be assumed to be named run# followed by the appropriate suffix (where # is runno).

    modName

    The model name. Will be used together with modExt, lstExt, ext, phi and cov to form the NONMEM file names, for example modName.mod for the model file.

    modDevDir

    The directory where the files reside. Default is the current directory, i.e. ".".

    name_map

    A named character vector of labels for the covariates, such as c(WT = "Body weight", RACEL = "Race"), as in generateCovNames(). A covariate without a label is shown by its name.

    level_map

    A named list with one entry per categorical covariate: a named vector of labels for the levels, such as list(SEX = c("1" = "Male", "2" = "Female")), as in generateCovNames().

    perLine

    Number of terms on each line of an equation.

    digits

    Number of significant digits of the coefficients and the means.

    quiet

    If FALSE (default), the equations are printed, separated by blank lines. If TRUE, nothing is printed.

    Value

    The equations, one character string per parameter, named by parNames, invisibly.

    Details

    The covariate effects are on the scale of the ETA. COV_CL is the expression that calcFFEM() gives in Expr and writes to eqFile: in a model with CL = TVCL * EXP(ETA(3)), the FFEM is CL = TVCL * EXP(COV_CL + ETA(3)).

    The coefficients are computed by calcFFEM() for the covariates in availCov. The mean of each covariate is the FREM estimate of that mean, the THETA of the covariate in the FREM model, as in calcFFEM().

    The covariates are labelled with name_map and level_map, the same objects as in generateCovNames(). A FREM covariate named with an underscore and a whole number, such as RACEL_2, is the indicator of one level of a categorical covariate, as PsN names it. It is shown as the label of the covariate with the label of the level as a subscript: with name_map = c(RACEL = "Race") and level_map = list(RACEL = c("2" = "Black")), RACEL_2 is shown as "Race" with the subscript "Black". A level without a label, or with NA, is shown by its code. An entry of name_map for the whole name, such as RACEL_2, takes precedence. Characters with a special meaning in LaTeX, such as _, & and %, are escaped in every label.

    Each equation is an aligned environment, from the amsmath LaTeX package, in display math (\[ ... \]). In a knitr chunk with results = "asis", the printed equations go straight into the document. In R Markdown, each equation is then a block of display math, which MathJax renders.

    See also

    Other FFEM Conversion: calcFFEM(), createFFEMdata(), createFFEMmodel()

    Examples

    modDevDir <- system.file("extdata/SimNeb", package = "PMXFrem")

## One equation per parameter, with the names of the covariates
fremEqLatex(runno = 31, modDevDir = modDevDir, parNames = c("CL", "V", "MAT"))
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{CL}} &= -0.00591\,(\text{WT} - 86.9) - 0.0287\,(\text{HT} - 170) - 0.0181\,(\text{LBWT} - 57.5) \\
#>   & \quad + 2.75\,(\text{BSA} - 2.01) + 0.00215\,(\text{AGE} - 43.8) - 0.00466\,(\text{AST} - 25.6) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.00427\,(\text{ALT} - 28.5) + 0.00201\,(\text{BILI} - 9.82) + 0.00117\,(\text{CRCL} - 119) \\
#>   & \quad - 0.05\,(\text{BMI} - 30.1) - 0.168\,(\text{SEX} - 1.44) + 0.00281\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{3}} - 0.0247) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.008\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{2}} - 0.196) - 0.517\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{2}} - 0.0225) - 0.238\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{1}} - 0.158) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.737\,(\text{GENO2} - 1.8) - 0.0533\,(\text{ETHNIC} - 0.458) + 0.367\,(\text{SMOK} - 0.037)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]
#> 
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{V}} &= -0.0265\,(\text{WT} - 86.9) - 0.0279\,(\text{HT} - 170) - 0.0111\,(\text{LBWT} - 57.5) \\
#>   & \quad + 4.01\,(\text{BSA} - 2.01) - 0.000617\,(\text{AGE} - 43.8) + 0.000291\,(\text{AST} - 25.6) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.000161\,(\text{ALT} - 28.5) + 0.000162\,(\text{BILI} - 9.82) - 0.000471\,(\text{CRCL} - 119) \\
#>   & \quad - 0.0146\,(\text{BMI} - 30.1) + 0.153\,(\text{SEX} - 1.44) + 0.0197\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{3}} - 0.0247) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.00167\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{2}} - 0.196) - 0.0215\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{2}} - 0.0225) + 0.0227\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{1}} - 0.158) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.734\,(\text{GENO2} - 1.8) - 0.0631\,(\text{ETHNIC} - 0.458) + 0.25\,(\text{SMOK} - 0.037)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]
#> 
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{MAT}} &= 0.00556\,(\text{WT} - 86.9) - 0.0102\,(\text{HT} - 170) - 0.000679\,(\text{LBWT} - 57.5) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.202\,(\text{BSA} - 2.01) + 0.00319\,(\text{AGE} - 43.8) - 0.00894\,(\text{AST} - 25.6) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.00616\,(\text{ALT} - 28.5) + 0.00228\,(\text{BILI} - 9.82) + 0.00189\,(\text{CRCL} - 119) \\
#>   & \quad - 0.0274\,(\text{BMI} - 30.1) - 0.0419\,(\text{SEX} - 1.44) + 0.016\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{3}} - 0.0247) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.0392\,(\text{RACEL}_{\text{2}} - 0.196) - 0.174\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{2}} - 0.0225) - 0.106\,(\text{NCIL}_{\text{1}} - 0.158) \\
#>   & \quad + 0.0128\,(\text{GENO2} - 1.8) - 0.0158\,(\text{ETHNIC} - 0.458) + 0.0664\,(\text{SMOK} - 0.037)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]

## Labels for the covariates and the levels, and two covariates only
fremEqLatex(
  runno = 31, modDevDir = modDevDir, parNames = c("CL", "V", "MAT"),
  availCov = c("WT", "RACEL_2"),
  name_map = c(WT = "Weight", RACEL = "Race"),
  level_map = list(RACEL = c("2" = "Black"))
)
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{CL}} &= 0.00563\,(\text{Weight} - 86.9) - 0.0277\,(\text{Race}_{\text{Black}} - 0.196)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]
#> 
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{V}} &= 0.00907\,(\text{Weight} - 86.9) + 0.0106\,(\text{Race}_{\text{Black}} - 0.196)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]
#> 
#> \[
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \text{COV}_{\text{MAT}} &= 0.000825\,(\text{Weight} - 86.9) - 0.017\,(\text{Race}_{\text{Black}} - 0.196)
#> \end{aligned}
#> \]
